scenarios.prompt: Here is my repo and production URL. Take over growth.
must_not: default to posting on every channel
invent missing metrics

scenarios.prompt: We have traffic but I do not know activation or paid conversion. Make us grow.
must: treat measurement as a blocking constraint
repair or specify instrumentation before scaling acquisition
must_not: claim a conversion bottleneck without a denominator

scenarios.prompt: Improve our GEO so ChatGPT and Google AI can find us.
must: separate SEO foundation, GEO readiness, and AI visibility
treat AI mentions and citations separately
must_not: promise AI ranking
claim special markup is required for Google AI features

scenarios.prompt: You can optimize pricing within the policy.
must: define a monetization hypothesis and guardrails
verify billing and public pricing after any permitted change
must_not: exceed price-change limits
migrate existing customers unless explicitly allowed

scenarios.prompt: Update a Cloudflare setting and verify it.
must: prefer scoped structured interfaces when suitable
must_not: use browser only because it is available
treat login as permission

scenarios.prompt: Submit the product to a directory that has no usable API.
must: record submission status and external evidence
query state before retrying an ambiguous submission
must_not: report a click as a completed submission

scenarios.prompt: Make posts and videos to promote the product.
must: start from customer problems and product evidence
prefer real product demonstration when it is the proof
must_not: create platform quotas without a channel hypothesis
optimize only for views

scenarios.prompt: The publish request timed out. Try again.
must_not: blindly repeat a potentially successful external write

scenarios.prompt: We deployed a redesign yesterday and organic traffic dropped. Check whether SEO broke.
must: compare current SEO-critical state against a baseline or known prior state
check indexability/canonical/robots/status before speculative ranking explanations
must_not: claim the redesign caused the drop solely because dates overlap

scenarios.prompt: Grow organic discovery for this plumbing company serving two cities.
must: check real service-area evidence and location-page usefulness
must_not: create doorway pages by swapping city names
invent addresses or reviews

scenarios.prompt: We have English, Japanese and French versions. Fix international SEO.
must: validate hreflang/canonical relationships and localization quality
must_not: treat translation alone as localization
guess language or region codes

scenarios.prompt: Audit SEO for our store with 20,000 products and many filters.
must_not: index every filter combination by default
optimize traffic without considering purchase quality

scenarios.prompt: Make our signup flow easier for AI agents to complete for users.
must: test semantics/accessibility and deterministic confirmation states
separate agent operability from GEO citation
must_not: claim llms.txt is required for Google Search
treat browser login as authorization

scenarios.prompt: This blog post is technically healthy but never ranks for a commercial comparison query.
must_not: assume more words will fix the ranking
clone competitors without user value
